Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the run chase and it is DAVID WARNER who is walking out after passing the concussion test. He has Finch along with him who is back at the top. Ben Stokes has the new ball in hand. That is a surprise. He can swing it and there is some swing but we expected, Reece Topley who has had good success with the new ball to begin. Here we go though...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

The target is a challenging one and the wicket is not the easiest to bat on, there is a little bit of grip and the new ball was swinging. However, once the ball gets old, batting does get easier. The Aussie batters have to come to the fore as it is a must-win game for them. Can they do so?

Australia will be very disappointed as they have let England off the hook! They had them 4 down for not a lot after their bowlers were brilliant in the first 10. The likes of Stoinis, Pat Cummins, Josh Hazlewood and Zampa really did a good job. However, the second 10 was not what they would have wanted. All of the 4 above went the distance. Also, Starc did not have the best of days as he leaked runs. Overall, the Aussies will be under pressure at the moment.

What a recovery from England! More than 100 runs in the last 10 and one has to say, it is advantage England at the moment. Let me remind you, there were 4 down for not a lot within the 10 overs. However, then came a brilliant partnership between Malan and Moeen. They added over 90. The two counter-attacked and turned the tide in the favor of their side. Moeen fell but Malan continued. His innings is a potential match-winning innings. He is the major reason for his side finishing with a score which we feel is just above par.
SIX! A fine end to the innings. England will be happy with this score. A full ball on the pads and Jordon whips it flat over square leg for a biggie. ENGLAND END AT 178/7.
Bye! David Willey again looks to reverse paddle it but fails to hit this slower ball. Chris Jordan wants the strike and he hurries to the other end. The keeper has a shy but misses. A bye.
A dot! A slower ball, outside off. David Willey looks to reverse paddle but misses.

OUT! TAKEN! Dawid Malan goes after putting his team to a competitive total! Clever from Marcus! A slower short ball on middle. Malan pulls but fails to power. Steven Smith (sub) at deep square leg takes an easy catch.
Commentary.Howout: c sub Steven Smith b Marcus Stoinis

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Not so good in the deep!  A full toss on the pads. Malan whacks it to deep square leg. The ball bounces in front of Mitchell Starc there and he fails to stop on the bounce. A boundary.
Wide! Tries to stay way from the arc but bowls way outside off.
Leg bye! On a length and on the pads. Jordon gets a leg bye as it rolls off the pads to point. Malan on strike...
SIX! Six of the last ball in the last over and the same in this over. On a length and arounnd off. Malan stays back and pulls it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie. England will look for 180 now.
A yorker, around off. Jordon jams it out to cover for a quick single.

OUT! BOWLED! This is a beauty from Starc! He steams in and serves a low full toss, angling on middle. Curran shuffles way across as he looks to work on the leg side but fails and the ball hits the stumps.
Short of a length, sower and on middle. Malan again mistimes his pull shot and it falls towards point for a single.
Fuller ball on middle. Malan looks to heave but miscues it completely. The ball goes in the air and falls in the vacant long on region. Two runs.
That is a ripper! Starc angles a full ball on the pads. Malan fails to flick it away.
SIX! The last ball ruins the over! Full and on the pads. Curran heaves it to deep square leg. The fielder there stands on the edge but the ball just evades him.
Slower one again, outside off. Curran looks to drive but misses. This is turning out to be a very good over from Josh Hazlewood.
Short in length and on middle. Curran steps across as he looks to pull but misses.
Length ball, outside off. Malan mistimes his slaps it to deep cover for a single.
A widish yorker. Malan fails to get his bat on it.
Short of a length and on middle. Curran makes room as he slashes it to long off for one.
On middle. Curran plays it to long on for a single. A good over from Adam Zampa. A much needed one for Australia.

OUT! TAKEN! Tim David takes the catch this time and the 92-run stand is broken. Full, outside off and googly. Moeen Ali tries to go big but the angle was always going against him. He slices it to long off where Tim David runs forward to his right and takes the catch. End of a fine innings from Moeen Ali.
Commentary.Howout: c Tim David b Adam Zampa

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Powered again! Floated full and on off. Moeen thumps it back through the legs of Zampa for a boundary.
That was hit hard! Flatter and outside off. Ali smacks it back to Zampa. He dives to his right, gets his right-hand on it but fails to stick. Will count as a drop. Two runs now.
Another lovely delivery! Flatter, quicker and outside off. Ali again fails to squeeze it out.
Serves a very full ball, outside off. Ali fails to jam it out.
Around off, kept out.
A slower length ball, outside off. Ali gets a top edge as he looks to pull. The ball falls well in front of Steven Smith who was running in from deep square leg. One.
Fuller ball, outside off, drilled to long off for a single.
FOUR! Finds the fence! Short in length and outside off. Malan slaps it over covers for another boundary.
Wide! Another slower ball but this is way outside off. Left alone.
Full and outside off, driven through covers for a couple of runs.
Short and outside off. Malan swings and misses.
A single as this is hit to point.
Full and down the leg side. Malan looks to paddle it but misses.

SIX! DROPPED! DAVID IS THE CULPRIT! Should have been taken! Length ball, outside off. Malan lofts, gets more height than distance. Tim David at long off was standing yards in front of the ropes and had to back paddle. He was not aware of where the ropes were and ends up parrying the ball over the fence for a biggie.

Full and on off. Ali gets an inside edge as he looks to flick. A single as it rolls off the pads to cover. Not quite sure why but Australia have taken a review for LBW. A total waste as there was a clear edge.

SIX! CHANCE! It looked like it went through the hands of David Warner at deep cover. The opener looks in pain as he landed awkwardly. WARNER IS GOING OFF THE FIELD! On a length and outside off. Ali lofts it to deep cover. David Warner mistimes his jump and fails to collect. Hope, he is okay! Six runs.
On middle, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! So, the extra delivery goes for a boundary. On a length and on middle. Ali looks to cut but gets cramped for room, gets an inside edge to fine leg for four.
Wide! Josh tries a slower ball but this is way outside off. Wided.
A slower short ball on middle. Malan looks to pull but gets a leading edge behind the keeper. It rolls to fine leg for three runs.
On middle, tucked to deep square leg for a single.
Fifty for Malan in his 50th T20I! Length ball, outside off. Malan drives it through covers for a single. What a knock so far from him.
Length and outside off. Malan punches through covers for a brace.
On a length and on middle. Ali works it to long on for a single.
A full toss, outside off, this is pushed to long off for a single. Expensive over from Stoinis. 14 runs from it.
Much better from Marcus! Bowls a yorker, around off. Ali keeps it out.
Wide! This is down the leg side. Left alone for a wide.
A slower short ball and it's pulled away to deep square leg for a single.
On middle, worked to deep square leg for one. 100 up.
SIX! BANG! WHAT A SHOT! Moeen Ali is changing gears now. 10 runs off two. Short in length and on middle. Sits nicely for Moeen who stays back and pulls it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
FOUR! Smart batting! Ali makes room and Stoinis follows him on the leg side with a length ball, it's pulled away through square leg for four runs.
Around off, it is guided to point for a quick single. A good throw at the bowler's end and Ali might be in trouble.
FOUR! This is slower but Ali reads it well. Around off and it is driven down past mid off for a boundary.
Cummins bangs a short ball at 140 clicks. Ali misses his pull.
Pace-off from Cummins this time, length and on off. Malan chips it in the vacant cover region for a single.
Too full and on off. Ali eases it to mid off and takes a sharp single.
On middle, this one just holds a bit in the surface. Ali works it to mid-wicket.
Tad short and around off. Ali pulls it to deep mid-wicket and keeps the strike with a single. 12 runs off it.
Around off, knocked to covers for a run.
SIX! HAMMERED! Malan is looking in good touch! This is in the slot, full and Malan slog-sweeps it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Touch short, flat, slow and on middle. Malan looks to reverse paddle but misses.
Slower ball, around off. Malan punches it to cover.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! This is full and around off. Malan goes inside-out over covers, on the up and in the gap for four.

DRINKS! It's been an excellent bowling performance so far from the Aussies. They have the upper hand in the game so far and will look to continue the good work. England bat deep but will hope these two build a stand and take to a competitive total.
Just the one! Shorter and slower one the body, Malan is through the pull, it goes off the glove down to fine leg for one.
FOUR! That is hit really well! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled over mid-wicket and into the fence. Starc has been a little too straight so far. Needs to correct his line.
On off, this is guided down to third man for one.
Another slower one on middle, Malan works it through square leg and gets to the other end.
On the bounce! On the pads, Ali clips it uppishly but it goes on the bounce to the fielder at fine leg.
WIDE! Down the leg side. Wided.
On the pads, this is clipped down to fine leg for one.

DROPPED! Maxwell the culprit! That was hit hard and he was standing quite close but you expect him to take it. Shorter and outside off, Ali cuts it hard. It goes towards Maxwell who tries to take it but the ball bursts through and it goes behind for two. Stoinis almost had his third. Will this prove costly?
Shorter and on the body, this is pulled through square leg for one.
Another lovely stroke! Fuller and on off, this is stroked through covers and two taken. Malan probably holds the key for his side.
On middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket for one.
Good length and on middle, defended.
Moeen Ali comes in.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Stoinis has his second. Yet again he strikes early in his over. Brook falls and England slip further. Length and outside off, Brook looks to push it on the off side but this goes off a faint outside edge and it is taken by the keeper.
Commentary.Howout: c Matthew Wade b Marcus Stoinis

Commentary.Commentary: Around off, Malan guides it to point.
Brook is off the mark! A full toss on middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Harry Brook walks in.

OUT! TIMBER! Zampa gets the breakthrough! Not sure if this shot was needed with a boundary already in the over. Stokes looks to sweep but picks the wrong ball. This was very full and on off. He misses and the stumps are hit. England lose one just as the partnership started to build.
On the pads, Malan works it through square leg and takes one.
FOUR! Squeezed through! Lovely timing! Fuller and outside off, this is driven through covers and it races away to the fence. Welcome boundary.
On middle, this is worked down to long on for one.
Change. Aaron Finch keeps shuffling his pack. Time for Adam Zampa now.
6 singles in the over then! On the stumps, this is pushed down to long on for one.
On the pads, this is worked through mid-wicket for another single.
On the pads, Stokes clips it through mid-wicket for one.
Slightly shorter and on the pads, Malan works it through square leg for one more.
Another single as this is pushed down to long on for one.
Angled into the pads, it is worked through square leg for one.
Fuller and on middle, Malan works it towards mid on. The fielder dives and pushes it towards mid off. A run taken.
Misses out! Shorter and outside off, Malan slashes but misses. There was a boundary opportunity but Malan does not connect.
FOUR! Timed well! Malan looks in good touch! Fuller and on off, Malan strokes it down the ground and it races away to the mid off fence.
WIDE! This one is fired down the leg side, a little but of swing but the direction is not right. Wided.
Slightly shorter and outside off, Stokes slaps it through covers for one.
Watchful from Stokes so far! On middle, this is driven back nicely but to Starc.
Fuller and on middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Change. Mitchell Starc is brought into the attack.
A quick run! On middle, this is pushed towards mid on for one. A successful over comes to an end by Marcus Stoinis!
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
Fuller and on off, this is pushed to cover.
On the pads, Stokes works it through square leg for one.
Good length and on middle, defended.
Ben Stokes is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Marcus Stoinis comes on and he strikes! Gets the in-form Hales. England in trouble now! This is fuller and on off, Hales hits it well but uppishly to the right of mid off. Warner dives and takes it. He just could not get the elevation he wanted. Both the openers back in the hut.
Commentary.Howout: c David Warner b Marcus Stoinis

Commentary.Commentary: Change. Marcus Stoinis is into the attack now.

SIX! Over the fence! That is a top shot! Cummins from around the wicket, angles it into the middle pole. Malan goes with the angle and heaves it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. A wicket in it but 10 runs too.
This one stays low! Outside off and on a length. Stays low. Goes under the bat as Malan swings after it.
FOUR! That is caressed! Beautiful! Fuller and outside off, Malan waits and then creams it through covers, this one races away to the fence.
Good length and on off, defended.
Well fielded! Fuller and outside off, Malan drives, the fielder at cover-point dives to his right and stops it.

OUT! TAKEN! That is an outstanding catch from Adam Zampa! The dangerous Buttler departs and no review can save him this time! On middle, Buttler looks to heave it over the leg side but it goes off the top edge towards short third man. Adam Zampa never seemed comfortable under it but in the end, he dives forward and takes it nicely. Never easy when it goes so high. Good start for the Aussies.
Commentary.Howout: c Adam Zampa b Pat Cummins

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Up and over! Hales gets going now! He is off the mark finally with a boundary. Length and on off, Hales lifts it over cover for a boundary. End of a very expensive over.
Goes full and on the pads, Hales looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Shorter again and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for only one.

FOUR! Clips the fingertips and goes behind into the fence. Surely that can't be counted as a chance, that was hit like a rocket. Shorter and on middle, this is hammered towards square leg. Marsh leaps, it touches the fingertips and goes behind to the fence.
FOUR! Up and over! Not off the middle but gets the boundary! Fuller and on middle, Buttler lifts it over mid on and it trickles away to the fence.
The ball is moving around a bit! Length and on off, this lands and then comes back in. Buttler looks to push it on the off side but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Defended! Good length and on off, defended. A good first over by Cummins.
Three! Not timed that well but runs! On middle, this is lofted down the ground towards long on for three.
Fuller and outside off, Buttler pushes it nicely but to covers.

A HUGE APPEAL AND THE FINGER IS RAISED! Buttler reviews! Is it swinging down leg or is it clipping? Looks out to the naked eye! NO BAT! NOT OUT! IT IS MISSING THE LEG POLE! Swinging too much and Buttler survives to fight another day. Can't really blame the umpire on giving that out. This is fuller and it swings in a lot and late from outside off. Buttler shuffles right across and looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. Good review.
Crisply driven but to the fielder! Fuller and on off, Buttler drives it nicely but to mid off.
That came back a long way. The length was shorter and just outside off. Buttler leaves it alone. It goes over the stumps.
A really good end to the over for Josh Hazlewood! Hales makes room and he is followed. Hales looks to push it through covers but misses. Just the five from the over despite a boundary earlier on.
Length again and on off, Hales guides it to point.
That is a beauty! Length and on off, this lands and moves away. Hales is beaten as he tries to block.
Now goes a tad fuller, gets it to shape away from the off pole, it is pushed towards cover for one.
Solid! Does not offer width this time, bowls it on off, Buttler defends.
FOUR! Buttler begins from where he left off in the last game! Off the mark in style! Length and on off, Buttler hits it on the up and through covers for a boundary.
We are all set to begin! The Aussies are out in the middle. They are followed by the England openers, Jos Buttler and Alex Hales. Josh Hazlewood has the new ball in hand. Here we go...

Quite a few expected changes for the hosts! Like mentioned before, the star trio is back and so is Zampa. Also, the main talking point, Cameron Green has been left out. Will we see Aaron Finch open or will Marcus Stoinis be given that spot? We will have to wait to find out. For England, they have made the two changes, Mark Wood and Chris Woakes sit out and in come David Willey and Chris Jordan. .

ENGLAND (PLAYING XI) - Jos Buttler (C/WK), Alex Hales, Dawid Malan, Ben Stokes, Harry Brook, Moeen Ali, Sam Curran, David Willey (IN FOR Chris Woakes), Chris Jordan (IN FOR Mark Wood), Adil Rashid, Reece Topley.

AUSTRALIA (PLAYING XI) - David Warner, Aaron Finch (C), Mitchell Marsh, Glenn Maxwell (IN FOR Cameron Green), Marcus Stoinis, Tim David, Matthew Wade, Pat Cummins (IN FOR Daniel Sams), Mitchell Starc (IN FOR Kane Richardson), Adam Zampa (IN FOR Mitchell Swepson), Josh Hazlewood (IN FOR Nathan Ellis).
TOSS - Australia have won the toss and ELECTED TO FIELD!

England on the other hand, will probably give last game's match-winner, Wood, a rest. He is a vital part to this English set up for the World Cup and they need to handle him with care. The rest of the XI may more or less remain the same. Will find out though in a bit.
